run_fw_kernel: run the _fw_kernel Triton forward pass to render features from triplane or voxel grid representations along rays
run_bw_kernel: run the _bw_kernel Triton backward pass to compute gradients for triplane, MLP weights, and color representations
sample_grid_rep: sample grid representations using _grid_sample for triplane or _voxel_grid_sample for voxel grid with trilinear interpolation
splat_grid_rep: splat gradients back to grid representations using _grid_splat for triplane or _voxel_grid_splat for voxel grid
int_to_randn: generate normally distributed random values from integer seeds using hash-based Box-Muller transform in _int_to_randn
